chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Muhammad ibn al-Musawir, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام) saying: “Beware of publicizing it. By Allah, your Imam will surely go into ghaybah for years of your time, and you will surely be tested and purified until it is said: He died, he was killed, he perished, in which valley did he travel? And the eyes of the believers will surely shed tears over him, and you will surely be overturned as ships are overturned in the waves of the sea.”

Then none will be saved except one whose covenant Allah has taken, and in whose heart He has written faith, and whom He has supported with a spirit from Him. And twelve confusing banners will surely be raised, such that it will not be known which is which.

He said: So I wept, then I said: So what should we do? He said: Then he looked at sunlight entering the veranda and said: O Abu Abdillah, do you see this sun? I said: Yes. He said: By Allah, our matter is clearer than this sun.

key_terms.إِمَامُكُمْ: your Imam, the divinely appointed leader of the community
key_terms.التَّنْوِيهَ: publicizing or drawing attention to the matter
key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ: faith firmly established in the heart
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers who remain faithful through the trial
key_terms.رَايَةً مُشْتَبِهَةً: a confusing banner or claim that resembles truth and causes uncertainty
key_terms.رُوحٍ: a spirit from Allah by which the believer is strengthened
key_terms.لَتُمَحَّصُنَّ: you will surely be tested and sifted thoroughly
key_terms.مِيثَاقَهُ: His covenant, denoting divine binding commitment and selection

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) say about the trials and confusion during the ghaybah of the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the severe trial of the Imam’s ghaybah, during which believers will face confusion, grief, and competing claims. It teaches that salvation in that period belongs to those firmly established in iman by Allah, while affirming that the truth of the Ahl al-Bayt’s matter remains utterly clear despite the confusion of people.
